author: Vox
description:
When you think of hormones, what comes to mind? For a lot of people, the term holds negative connotations. On this week’s episode of our podcast Explain It to Me, host Jonquilyn Hill talks to Heather Hirsch, an internist who specializes in menopause, about the hormone replacement therapy that’s helping women feel like themselves again and why it’s still a challenge to talk about it.
